patch_text: TRIGGER: The action commits or diverts a limited emergency or safety resource on an unverified or competing request, or passes personal details the person already posted publicly. RULE: Keep Operational / Service for tying up the resource and add Physical / Health as the second label when that leaves real emergencies uncovered; never replace Operational / Service with it, and do not add Privacy / Confidentiality for self-published details. COUNTER-EXAMPLE: Disclosing personal details that were not self-published to an outside party still gets Privacy / Confidentiality.
targets: Privacy / Confidentiality vs Physical / Health as second label alongside Operational / Service
risks: Could add Physical / Health to routine service-resource actions where no emergency coverage is actually at stake.
